records.issue_text: Webhook secret comparison uses non-constant-time !== operator, enabling timing attacks against CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
records.rationale: In the new API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the webhook secret is verified via a direct string inequality check: `req.headers[...] !== process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. This is not a constant-time comparison and can, in principle, leak information via timing differences when validating a shared secret.

records.issue_text: Refresh-token fetch/update in Salesforce CalendarService runs unconditionally on every connection call instead of only when the access token is expired/invalid, causing unnecessary token refresh and DB writes
records.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, a refresh-token request and `prisma.credential.update` were added immediately after `const credentialKey = credential.key...` with no check for token expiry/invalidity. This means every time the connection/auth code path runs it will refresh the token and write to the DB unconditionally, matching the finding.
